shots.kf: Close-up of a generic sleek silver semi-truck cab with a distinct blue horizontal stripe. The truck is parked outdoors on asphalt. Soft diffused morning light, cinematic 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Monochromatic silver and blue color palette. Photorealistic, premium commercial look, unbranded.

shots.kf: A clean, empty warehouse loading dock interior. Large open roll-up doors reveal bright daylight outside. Industrial concrete floor, minimalist setting. Wide-angle 24mm lens, deep depth of field, high contrast lighting. Neutral gray and white color palette. Photorealistic, generic, unbranded space.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pans horizontally across the empty loading bays, capturing the atmospheric dust in the light beams.

shots.kf: The generic sleek silver semi-truck with a blue stripe driving along the modern Corridor 10 highway in North Macedonia. Rolling green hills in the background. Mid-day sunlight, 50mm lens, dynamic angle. Natural greens, greys, and blues. Photorealistic, crisp and clear.
shots.motion: The truck drives forward along the highway while the camera slowly tracks alongside it, keeping the vehicle centered.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a bright modern warehouse interior filled with perfectly stacked wooden pallets of unbranded cardboard boxes. High ceiling with industrial LED lights. Symmetrical composition, 35mm lens. Warm wood and cool white lighting palette. Photorealistic, pristine logistics environment.
shots.motion: The camera slowly cranes up, revealing the massive scale of the neatly organized storage racks.

shots.kf: The generic sleek silver semi-truck with a blue stripe parked peacefully at a modern rest stop. Dramatic golden hour sunset sky overhead, casting long shadows. Low angle 35mm lens. Rich orange, purple, and silver color palette. Photorealistic, cinematic and majestic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly glides sideways around the parked truck as the sunset light reflects off the shiny metal surface.

shots.kf: A 35-year-old male courier with short brown hair, wearing a clean, unbranded yellow polo shirt and dark trousers. He is holding a plain cardboard box in a generic sorting facility. Soft overhead lighting, 50mm lens, medium shot. Warm yellow and neutral gray palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: The courier gently adjusts the box in his arms while the camera slowly dollies backward.

shots.kf: Heavy traffic on a generic wide city boulevard in Skopje during golden hour. Blurry cars and buses waiting at a red light. Deep depth of field, 85mm lens. Warm orange and amber color palette, cinematic sun flares. Photorealistic, urban atmosphere.
shots.motion: The cars inch forward slowly in the dense traffic as the camera subtly pans to the right.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old male courier with short brown hair, wearing the yellow polo shirt, driving a small white unbranded electric delivery van down a narrow residential street. Window down, dappled sunlight through trees. 35mm lens, eye-level. Green and white palette. Photorealistic.

shots.kf: Silhouette of a person standing at a residential doorway, holding a plain cardboard parcel. Warm interior light spilling out onto the front porch. Evening setting, 50mm lens. High contrast, dark blues and warm yellows palette. Photorealistic, emotive and anonymous.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old male courier with short brown hair, wearing the yellow polo shirt, walking towards the camera on a quiet sidewalk with a gentle smile. Soft afternoon sunlight, 85mm lens, blurred background. Warm, inviting color palette. Photorealistic, premium commercial look.
shots.motion: The courier walks forward at a relaxed pace while the camera tracks backward, keeping him perfectly framed.

shots.kf: Vertical framing. Close-up of heavy, frost-covered metallic doors of a generic refrigerated truck. Thick white cold mist pouring out from the bottom edge. High contrast industrial lighting, 35mm lens. Cool blue and icy white color palette. Photorealistic, crisp textures.
shots.motion: The heavy metal doors slowly swing open outward, releasing a thick, rolling cloud of dense cold mist.

shots.kf: Vertical framing. A generic unbranded yellow forklift moving a perfectly wrapped pallet of fresh green apples inside a massive cold storage room. Bright fluorescent lighting, 24mm wide lens. Vibrant green, yellow, and sterile white palette. Photorealistic, clean logistics environment.
shots.motion: The forklift slowly drives forward through the cold room as the camera tilts down from the ceiling.

shots.kf: Vertical framing. A brightly lit supermarket display aisle filled with vibrant, dew-covered fresh red tomatoes and green peppers. Overhead softbox lighting, macro 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Rich red and vivid green color palette. Photorealistic, premium organic look.
shots.motion: The camera slowly glides horizontally across the fresh, glistening vegetables, highlighting the water droplets on their surface.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a massive, brightly lit logistics warehouse interior with towering metal shelving units. No people, entirely automated environment. Clean concrete floors. Symmetrical composition, 14mm ultra-wide lens. Cool industrial blue and gray color palette. Photorealistic, futuristic and expansive.
shots.motion: The camera slowly dollies forward down the central aisle, emphasizing the vast scale of the facility.

shots.kf: An autonomous flat orange robotic cart sliding smoothly under a loaded wooden pallet of plain boxes. Low angle floor shot, 35mm lens. Clean warehouse environment, bright LED lighting. High contrast orange and grey color palette. Photorealistic, sharp focus on the robot.
shots.motion: The orange robotic cart glides forward perfectly straight along the smooth floor as the camera tracks alongside it.

shots.kf: A sleek metallic conveyor belt carrying identical plain brown cardboard boxes in a continuous line. Soft overhead factory lighting casting gentle shadows, 50mm lens, angled slightly downward for a clear view of the mechanism. Clean, highly organized industrial setting. Neutral brown, silver, and black color palette. Photorealistic, satisfying mechanical precision.
shots.motion: The brown boxes move steadily along the metal conveyor belt as the camera slowly pans to follow their path.

shots.kf: A glowing blue optical scanner casting a horizontal laser beam over a passing plain cardboard package on a track. Macro shot, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Dark background with intense blue light illumination. Neon blue and deep black color palette. Photorealistic.

shots.kf: A massive automated yellow crane lifting a heavy pallet of goods high up toward the top tier of a storage rack. Dramatic upward angle, 24mm lens. Bright ceiling lights glowing above. Industrial yellow and steel grey color palette. Photorealistic, imposing machinery.
shots.motion: The yellow crane smoothly hoists the heavy pallet straight up towards the ceiling as the camera slowly tilts upward.

shots.kf: A generic unbranded white forklift parked neatly in a perfectly symmetrical warehouse aisle flanked by stacked pallets. Serene, quiet moment. Even, soft warehouse lighting, 35mm lens. Monochromatic white and beige color palette. Photorealistic, clean and highly structured logistics environment.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pulls back straight down the aisle, keeping the parked forklift perfectly centered in the frame.

shots.kf: Exterior wide shot of a vast modern logistics warehouse at dusk. Loading bay doors are illuminated with warm yellow light against the dark blue evening sky. 24mm lens, architectural composition. Twilight blue and warm yellow color palette. Photorealistic, premium corporate look.
shots.motion: The camera slowly cranes up into the evening sky, revealing the glowing exterior of the massive logistics center.

shots.kf: A moody, fog-covered morning landscape in North Macedonia, with an empty asphalt highway stretching into the distant mist. Soft, diffused dawn lighting, 35mm lens, atmospheric composition. Muted grey, deep green, and pale blue color palette. Photorealistic, cinematic and deeply peaceful.
shots.motion: The thick morning fog slowly rolls across the empty highway as the camera gently pushes forward.

shots.kf: Close-up of a large commercial truck's side mirror, reflecting the bright golden sunrise breaking through the clouds. The metallic casing of the mirror is sleek and unbranded. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. Vibrant orange and dark shadow color palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: The reflection of the sun slowly shifts across the glass of the mirror as the camera slightly pans.

shots.kf: A generic, unbranded border crossing toll booth bathed in the soft amber light of early morning. An empty lane with a raised red and white barrier gate. Wide cinematic angle, 24mm lens. Warm amber and cool concrete grey color palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: The red and white barrier gate remains fully raised as the camera slowly dollies forward through the empty lane.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of the massive, heavy rubber tires of a semi-truck rolling smoothly over wet, dark asphalt. Water droplets spraying slightly from the treads. High shutter speed look, 85mm lens. Dark grey, black, and silver color palette. Photorealistic, gritty texture.
shots.motion: The large truck tires roll steadily forward on the wet road as the camera tracks alongside them at ground level.

shots.kf: A sweeping wide landscape shot of a long unbranded commercial truck crossing a majestic, brutalist concrete highway bridge over a deep river valley in North Macedonia. Midday sun, 14mm ultra-wide lens. Lush valley greens and stark concrete greys. Photorealistic, epic scale.
shots.motion: The truck drives slowly across the massive concrete bridge while the camera gracefully cranes downward into the valley.

shots.kf: A breathtaking sunset over a distant, silhouetted city skyline. An empty highway leads directly toward the glowing horizon. Deep, dramatic clouds catching the fading light. 35mm lens, wide cinematic framing. Rich magenta, deep purple, and fiery orange color palette. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly tracks forward along the center of the empty highway, heading straight into the vibrant sunset.
